headline: Prognoza: do 2034 r. AI może dodać Polsce nawet 12 proc. PKB. Pod trzema warunkami
summary: A World Bank model suggests artificial intelligence could raise Poland's GDP by up to 12% above the baseline path by 2034. Only 8% of Polish firms currently use AI, and the country is ageing fast.
why: The World Bank is a multilateral lender that publishes economic projections used by governments and investors. Productivity gains from AI affect long-term growth outlooks.
